mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dining_tables ( store_id, code, capacity, created_by ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{code}, #{capacity}, #{createdBy} )
INSERT INTO table_qr_codes ( table_id, token, status, issued_at, revoked_at ) VALUES ( #{tableId}, #{token}, 'ACTIVE', #{issuedAt}, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT dining_tables.id AS id, dining_tables.code AS code, dining_tables.capacity AS capacity, table_qr_codes.token AS activeQrToken, table_sessions.status AS sessionStatus FROM dining_tables LEFT JOIN table_qr_codes ON table_qr_codes.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_sessions.status IN ('OPEN', 'PAYMENT_PENDING') WHERE dining_tables.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY dining_tables.code ASC

SELECT dining_tables.id AS tableId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_qr_codes.token AS token FROM dining_tables INNER JOIN table_qr_codes ON table_qr_codes.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE dining_tables.store_id = #{storeId} AND dining_tables.id = #{tableId}

SELECT dining_tables.id AS tableId, dining_tables.store_id AS storeId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_sessions.public_id AS sessionPublicId, table_sessions.status AS sessionStatus FROM table_qr_codes INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id = table_qr_codes.table_id LEFT JOIN table_sessions ON table_sessions.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_sessions.status IN ('OPEN', 'PAYMENT_PENDING') WHERE table_qr_codes.token = #{qrToken} AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT dining_tables.id AS tableId, dining_tables.store_id AS storeId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_sessions.public_id AS sessionPublicId, table_sessions.status AS sessionStatus FROM table_sessions INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id = table_sessions.table_id WHERE table_sessions.public_id = #{sessionPublicId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO table_sessions ( table_id, public_id, client_account_id, opened_by_customer_name, opened_by_customer_phone, status, payment_requested_at, closed_at ) VALUES ( #{tableId}, #{publicId}, #{clientAccountId}, #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, 'OPEN', NULL, NULL )
